name: Feature request

---

**Which contract/crate does this affect?**
e.g. `allowlist-token`, `denylist-gate`, `jurisdiction-flag`, repo-wide tooling

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the use case or gap this addresses.

**Proposed solution**
Describe the function signature(s), behavior, and any storage/event changes
you have in mind.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] ...
- [ ] Tests covering happy path and at least one failure/auth case
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them.
